external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor hosts the portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in the organization's cloud account into which supplier records are written.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in to the portal using credentials issued by the vendor.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and associated supplier contact details

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are incompatible claims about encryption in transit, so the value is unknown.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database.

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-hosted environment containing the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the text calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source names the component "Supplier document portal" and describes suppliers signing in and uploading through it.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform encrypts data at rest using the stated enterprise-grade encryption.
assumptions.basis: The vendor datasheet says the platform uses "enterprise-grade encryption throughout".

assumptions.assumption: The supplier portal upload flow uses the platform's stated enterprise-grade encryption in transit.
assumptions.basis: The vendor datasheet says the platform uses "enterprise-grade encryption throughout".

assumptions.assumption: The supplier sign-in flow uses the platform's stated enterprise-grade encryption in transit.
assumptions.basis: The vendor datasheet says the platform uses "enterprise-grade encryption throughout".

assumptions.assumption: The category manager review flow uses the platform's stated enterprise-grade encryption in transit.
assumptions.basis: The vendor datasheet says the platform uses "enterprise-grade encryption throughout".

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform's stored contents are confidential because they include compliance documents and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source says the platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket's stored contents are confidential because it receives the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source says the landing bucket receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database's stored contents are confidential because it contains supplier records including personal contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source describes supplier contact details and says the service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
